tasks.label: Build & Run FlowMac
tasks.command: pkill -x FlowMac 2>/dev/null; xcodebuild -project FlowMac.xcodeproj -scheme FlowMac -configuration Debug build && BUILT_DIR=$(xcodebuild -project FlowMac.xcodeproj -scheme FlowMac -configuration Debug -showBuildSettings 2>/dev/null | awk '/^ *BUILT_PRODUCTS_DIR =/{print $3}') && open "$BUILT_DIR/FlowMac.app"

tasks.label: Build FlowMac (Release)
tasks.command: pkill -x FlowMac 2>/dev/null; xcodebuild -project FlowMac.xcodeproj -scheme FlowMac -configuration Release build
